prompt: Which genes differ between human pancreatic cancer cell lines that acquired resistance to a KRAS inhibitor and their parental lines?
answers: Any KRAS inhibitor. Compare each resistant derivative with its own parental line, human cell lines only, as the series has them.

GSE269985.rationale: MRTX1133-resistant derivatives vs parental lines, three replicates each, untreated.
GSE269985.samples_note: Human Panc 02.03 and PANC-1 only; the 18 mouse samples (6694C2, 6499C4, 6419C5) are out and have no NCBI counts. GSM8332068 (resistant) is not in the count table. case: cell line = "Panc 02.03" or "PANC-1" and title = contains "resistant"; control: cell line = "Panc 02.03" or "PANC-1" and title = contains "parental"

GSE273116.rationale: Sotorasib-resistant MIA PaCa-2/SR vs parental MIA PaCa-2 (vehicle), but only two of the three SR vehicle samples are in the NCBI count table.

GSE234449.rationale: MRTX1133-resistant vs parental SUIT2, but two and one untreated human samples per arm.

GSE228010.rationale: Acute KRAS inhibitor vs DMSO; no resistant lines.

GSE201412.rationale: Acute MRTX1133 vs vehicle; no resistant lines.

GSE202532.rationale: Anoikis-resistant derivatives, not KRAS-inhibitor resistance; mouse mixed in.

GSE229070.rationale: Sotorasib-resistant H23 and H358: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

GSE204753.rationale: Sotorasib-resistant lung PDX cells: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

GSE164326.rationale: KRAS G12C inhibitor resistance in lung adenocarcinoma: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

GSE225060.rationale: Relapse after adagrasib combinations in SW837 xenografts: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

GSE71876.rationale: KRAS knockout clones, not inhibitor resistance; mouse mixed in.

notes: Same pool as the KRAS treatment case, different winners. GSE269985 mixes mouse and human lines.
